description: This file defines a class HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_HostBlacklist which extends another class HTMLPurifier_URIFilter. The class provides functionality to filter out URLs whose hostnames match entries in a blacklist, as part of the HTMLPurifier library's URI filtering mechanism.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_HostBlacklist
classes.description: A class that filters URLs based on a blacklist of host fragments.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the blacklist of host fragments from the configuration.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Checks if the provided URI's host matches any blacklisted fragment and filters it accordingly.
